HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0007.title: Consider app schemas for common functionality

statement.en: Consider app schemas instead of individual App Shortcuts for common functionality on supported devices.
statement.ja: supported device上のcommon functionalityにはindividual App Shortcutの代わりにapp schemaを検討する。

conditions: The app operates in a common domain area supported by app schemas.
Use App Shortcuts for unique features or custom content that app schemas don't cover.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0007.review_note: Corrected SHOULD to MAY from the explicit consider wording and preserved the uncovered-feature branch.

conditions: Offer predictable, familiar values because people may not see the option list.
The separate parameter rule records the single-optional-value limit.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0008.review_note: Activated the flexibility lead and separated the parameter-count contract.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0009.title: Use snippets for static information or dialog options

statement.en: Use a snippet when an App Shortcut response needs a custom view for static information or dialog options.
statement.ja: App Shortcut responseでstatic informationまたはdialog option用custom viewが必要な場合はsnippetを使う。

conditions: Suitable examples include local weather and order confirmation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0009.review_note: Recovered the snippet response-mode recommendation from descriptive prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0010.title: Use a Live Activity for changing time-spanning information

statement.en: Use a Live Activity when App Shortcut information remains relevant and changes over time.
statement.ja: App Shortcut informationが一定期間relevantで変化する場合はLive Activityを使う。

conditions: Suitable examples include timers and countdowns that last until an event completes.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0010.review_note: Recovered the Live Activity response-mode recommendation from descriptive prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0011.title: Use lowercase for individual shortcuts

statement.en: Use lowercase when referring to an individual shortcut rather than App Shortcuts or the Shortcuts app.
statement.ja: App ShortcutsやShortcuts appではなくindividual shortcutを指す場合はlowercaseを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0011.review_note: Activated the separate individual-shortcut editorial convention.

conditions: Place the most generally useful shortcuts first for initial Spotlight and Shortcuts ordering.
After use begins, the system prioritizes frequently used shortcuts.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0012.review_note: Activated the iOS and iPadOS ordering lead and preserved initial versus learned ordering.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0013.title: Require at least one action in every App Shortcut

statement.en: Ensure every App Shortcut includes at least one action.
statement.ja: 各App Shortcutに少なくとも1つのactionを含める。

conditions: Actions represent the steps people perform to accomplish a task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0013.review_note: Recovered the one-or-more-actions App Shortcut structure contract as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0014.title: Limit an app to 10 App Shortcuts

statement.en: Provide no more than 10 App Shortcuts in an app.
statement.ja: 1つのappで提供するApp Shortcutを10件以下にする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit system-supported maximum as a platform-contract MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0015.title: Limit an App Shortcut to one optional parameter

statement.en: Include no more than one optional value or parameter in an App Shortcut.
statement.ja: 1つのApp Shortcutに含めるoptional valueまたはparameterを1つ以下にする。

conditions: Include the parameter only when it makes sense for the task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0015.review_note: Recovered the single-optional-parameter platform constraint as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0016.title: Include all critical information in full App Shortcut dialogue

statement.en: Include all critical App Shortcut response information in the full dialogue text.
statement.ja: App Shortcut responseのcritical informationをすべてfull dialogue textに含める。

conditions: People may receive the response on an audio-only device or be unable to see the screen.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0016.review_note: Raised the direct critical-information requirement to an audio-accessibility MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0017.title: Include the app name in every activation phrase

statement.en: Include the app name in every App Shortcut activation phrase.
statement.ja: 各App Shortcut activation phraseにapp nameを含める。

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0017.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit You have to requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0018.title: Always title-case App Shortcuts and the Shortcuts app

statement.en: Always use title case when referring to App Shortcuts or the Shortcuts app.
statement.ja: App ShortcutsまたはShortcuts appを指す場合は常にtitle caseを使う。

conditions: Apply to the named feature and app, not individual shortcuts.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0018.review_note: Recovered MUST from the unqualified Always editorial directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0019.title: Ensure Shortcuts remains plural

statement.en: Ensure the word Shortcuts remains plural when naming App Shortcuts or the Shortcuts app.
statement.ja: App ShortcutsまたはShortcuts appの名称ではShortcutsをpluralのままにする。

conditions: Apply to the named feature and app, not individual shortcuts.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0019.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure naming directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0020.title: Represent every iOS and iPadOS App Shortcut

statement.en: Represent every iOS and iPadOS App Shortcut with an SF Symbol or a directly linked item's preview image.
statement.ja: 各iOS/iPadOS App ShortcutをSF Symbolまたはdirectly linked itemのpreview imageで表現する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0020.review_note: Recovered the per-shortcut iOS and iPadOS representation contract as MUST.

prior_batch_metadata.review_method: Rendered Apple HIG App Shortcuts overview, best-practice, response, editorial, platform, resource, availability, and change-log context was reviewed; two completed live renders matched the stored source hash.
prior_batch_metadata.review_note: Completed App Shortcuts coverage, activated six missed leads, recovered eight atomic requirements, separated App Shortcut count, action, parameter, activation-phrase, audio-only, naming, and iOS/iPadOS representation contracts, and retained platform availability boundaries.

review_method: One helper reviewed all20 rules in bounded section slices. Root independently checked all supporting overview, Best practices, response, editorial, and platform paragraphs. Corrected keyboard-shortcut misclassification, accessibility/voice priority, conditional wording, and template statements. Used the earlier reviewed Snippets trace as an explicit cross-page scope constraint, without fetching another page. Exact trace presence and semantic approval are separate checks.
unverified: App schema, Live Activity, and individual App Intent API availability across SDK/device versions was not independently verified; retain source availability conditions.
The same-day Snippets review constrains rule0009; linked SDK pages, media, and exact old full-page prose differences were not reviewed.

ci_verification.note: One CI run for this combined37-rule semantic change set. The later ID-map key-order formatting was verified to leave its parsed mapping unchanged.

extraction_verification.initial_registry_byte_check: Key-order-only mismatch; semantic entries identical. Resolved by applying the extractor localeCompare ordering.
extraction_verification.method: Isolated re-extraction reproduces the final canonical rules and ID registry byte-for-byte. The approved trace migration adds one new alias while retaining its old alias.

cross_page_constraints.decision: Intersect supported snippet platforms with current App Shortcuts platforms; retain only iOS and iPadOS.
